retrieval.rag_summary:
Thermotec Maxflex Pipe Insulation represents continuous-coil
elastomeric nitrile foam pipe insulation distributed for HVAC, air conditioning,
and domestic plumbing lines. Engineered from flexible closed-cell synthetic
rubber with built-in vapor barrier resistance, it prevents condensation and
thermal energy loss on refrigeration and hot water pipes. Pre-formed in long
continuous coils or 2m tubes, it slips easily over copper and plastic pipework
during installation.
